name: Better Stack MCP
tagline: Uptime monitoring, log management, and incidents from chat.
shortDescription: The Better Stack MCP server. Create uptime monitors, manage on-call schedules, query logs, and handle incidents. Uptime Robot + PagerDuty in one.
longDescription:
## What it is

Better Stack's official MCP server. Exposes the Better Stack API as MCP tools: create/manage uptime monitors, view incidents, query logs, manage on-call schedules, and post status page updates.

## Why we recommend it

Better Stack combines uptime monitoring, log management, on-call, and status pages in one. The MCP server lets your agent handle incidents conversationally — create monitors, page the right person, post updates.

## When to use it

- Uptime: agent adds monitors for new endpoints
- Incidents: agent triggers an incident, pages the on-call, posts a status update
- Logs: agent queries Better Stack Logs (built on ClickHouse)
- On-call: agent manages schedules and escalations
installInstructions:
1. Get an API token at https://betterstack.com/settings/api-tokens
2. Set `BETTERSTACK_TOKEN=...`
3. `npx -y @betterstack/mcp`

**Free tier:** 10 monitors, 5-minute checks, 3-day log retention.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Better Stack: 10 monitors free. Paid: from $25/month.
